name: P.T. Asuransi Multi Artha Guna Tbk
summary: P.T. Asuransi Multi Artha Guna Tbk provides a range of general insurance and reinsurance products in Indonesia. The company offers fire, earthquake, property / industrial all risk, heavy equipment, cargo/transportation, burglary, money, personal accident, health, travel, and suretyship insurance products. It also offers machinery, car loan, garage keeper liability, retail credit, oil and gas, business protection plus, fidelity guarantee, moveable all-risks, hole-in-one, neon sign, magna micro business, market consortium, magna credit, liability, micro standard, terrorism and sabotage, and marine hull insurance products, as well as insurance for cash in ATM and cash in management. It operates through a network of 20 branches and 16 representative offices. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Central Jakarta, Indonesia. P.T. Asuransi Multi Artha Guna Tbk is a subsidiary of Fairfax Asia Limited.
